power.jaymospowers.chrono.desc: Bend the flow of time. Rewind your last moments, freeze foes, and fast-forward yourself or the world.
power.jaymospowers.chrono.key.ability_2: Stasis Field: stop time around you for 3s (players too) and reset all your other cooldowns
power.jaymospowers.chrono.key.ability_3: Overclock: a speedster for 6 s (Speed V, faster blows), everyone near you slowed hard. Sprint to go far faster, run up walls and across water and lava; V again at a wall to phase through it. Hold Shift to walk at normal speed. All four abilities unlocked: a toggle, on until V again (away from a wall)
power.jaymospowers.chrono.key.ability_4: Time Bloom (grow and cook fast, and mend your wounds and those of every creature near you). Sneak+B, once you've killed your echo for good: Fast Forward, a leap to the ruined future (and back) with everyone near you
power.jaymospowers.chrono.key.ultimate: Chrono Punch: ten punches in half a second into everything in front of you
message.jaymospowers.chrono_rewind_short: Not enough time has passed to rewind.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_rewind_tangl: The timeline is tangled across dimensions.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_rewind_block: Your past is blocked. Something stands where you were.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_echo_sighted: Someone is walking where you walked.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_echo_collaps: Somewhere, a moment of yours finally ends.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_clock_woke: You wake. The ticking has stopped.
item.jaymospowers.chrono_stopped_clock.l: Both hands rest on the same moment.
It waits for one who has stood outside time.
power.jaymospowers.chrono.key.starter: Nudge time: slow what you look at (sneak: speed yourself)
message.jaymospowers.chrono_flow_unavail: Time won't flow for you like that. Not yet.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_flow_lent: The echo's blow lands out of time, and time begins to flow through you.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_flow_drained: The flow drains out of you.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_grab_none: No one close enough to seize.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_echo_stasis: Your own stillness, turned on you.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_echo_unravel: Your echo is gone for good, and the hole it leaves runs straight through you. Time comes loose.
power.jaymospowers.chrono.key.mode.ascen: Time Flow on/off (over-the-shoulder view): attack toward a foe to fly at it; right click to counter held blows, even mid-move. A counter leaves you intangible for a moment: a blow through you flashes red, and Space answers with a spinning kick that throws everyone round you away. Space again spends one of 3 roll charges on stopping time all round you
power.jaymospowers.chrono.key.ultimate.a: Chrono Punch (in Time Flow: lock onto a foe for a barrage, only a counter breaks it; the last punch throws everything in front away)
message.jaymospowers.future.recharging: The future won't open again for %s s.
message.jaymospowers.future.waiting: Lost between times... the future is forming (%s%%)
message.jaymospowers.future.arrived: A lifetime from now. The dead walk.
message.jaymospowers.future.credit: This future is built from Los Perrito City by Uospag (curseforge.com/minecraft/worlds/los-perrito, CC BY 4.0), ruined by Jaymo's Powers. Click to visit the map's page.
message.jaymospowers.future.echo_first: The future won't open while your echo still walks. End it for good first.
message.jaymospowers.future.woken: Your echo is gone for good, and you feel your own time pulling at you. Sneak+B to wake back where you belong.
message.jaymospowers.future.unlocked: Your echo is gone for good, and time lies open ahead of you. Sneak+B to fast forward.
power.jaymospowers.chrono.key.mode.ascen: Time Flow on/off (over-the-shoulder view): attack toward a foe to fly at it; right click to counter held blows, even mid-move. A counter leaves you intangible for a moment: a blow through you flashes red, and Space answers with a spinning kick that throws everyone round you away. Space again spends one of 3 roll charges on stopping time all round you
screen.jaymospowers.order.standby.desc: Your echo keeps near you and fights only what attacks it or you. Between fights it casts Time Bloom where it stands every 30 seconds (once you have Time Bloom).
screen.jaymospowers.order.harvest.desc: Round where you stand now, your echo reaps ripe crops (and replants them), and fells the logs and mines the ores you mine most. The drops go into a chest or barrel close by, or onto the ground.
screen.jaymospowers.order.guard.desc: Your echo holds where you stand now and fights every monster that comes near, with your own Chrono abilities.
screen.jaymospowers.order.loop.desc: Your echo goes back to repeating the recording in the loop slot picked below.
screen.jaymospowers.order.record.desc: Record up to a minute of what you do (where you walk, what you break, place and strike, the chests, levers, buttons and doors you use), into the loop slot picked below. Press again to stop: your echo repeats it there, over and over. It places blocks from what it carries or a chest close by, empties what it carries into the chests you used and takes out what it needs to place. Ripe crops only; reaped crops are replanted.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_order.standb: Your echo falls in beside you.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_order.guard: Your echo will hold this ground.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_order.loop: Your echo will walk this moment again, and again.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_order.record: Time is watching what you do...
power.jaymospowers.chrono.key.ultimate.a: Chrono Punch (in Time Flow: lock onto a foe for a barrage, only a counter breaks it; the last punch throws everything in front away)
screen.jaymospowers.order.locked: Not yet. This order comes after %s in-game days of play as Timeless.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_order.unlock: Your echo has learnt to reap for you. (Harvest)
Your echo has learnt to hold ground for you. (Guard)
Your echo has learnt to walk your moments again. (Record)
screen.jaymospowers.order.slot.empty: Loop slot %s: empty. Pick it, then Record.
screen.jaymospowers.order.clear.desc: Forget the recording in the loop slot in use.
screen.jaymospowers.order.slot.filled: Loop slot %s holds a recording. Pick it to loop it, or record over it.
screen.jaymospowers.chrono.recording: Recording into loop slot %s. Press Stop when you're done.
screen.jaymospowers.chrono.not_yours: Only a Chrono's echo takes orders.
screen.jaymospowers.chrono.not_timeless: Your echo is still your curse. Once you're Timeless, it takes your orders here.
message.jaymospowers.future.woke_again: You wake in the square again.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.opt.story: Tell them where you came from
talk.jaymospowers.omen.surprise.1: Hold on. Stop right there. You're... breathing. Nobody from before is breathing.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.surprise.2: No. No, that's not right. There's nobody left who walks in like that. Where did you come from?
talk.jaymospowers.omen.surprise.3: Wait. You're warm. Look at you, you're not tin and you're not one of the dead. How are you here?
talk.jaymospowers.omen.surprise.4: Easy. I'm not going to shoot. I just haven't seen anyone new in a long time. How did you get in?
talk.jaymospowers.omen.greet.first.1: Sorry for staring. Everyone I know is either gone or stuck in a cockpit. Tell me about you. Start wherever you like.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.greet.first.2: Sit a second, if you can. I want to hear how a person ends up out here. When and where did you start?
talk.jaymospowers.omen.greet.first.3: I've got a canteen and about ten minutes. Tell me where you're from and I'll tell you what I can.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.greet.again.1: Back again. Good. What do you want to know?
talk.jaymospowers.omen.greet.again.2: Still here. I keep thinking you'll fade out like the lights did. Ask me anything.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.greet.again.3: I'm glad it's you. Go on, ask.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.rest.1: Give me a minute. It's a lot to say out loud, and I haven't said any of it to anyone in a long while.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.rest.2: Not yet. Let me breathe. Talk to me about something else, or just stand here with me.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.rest.3: I'll get to the rest. I just need a minute with the last part first.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.done.1: That's all of it, as far as I know. The rest is out there somewhere in the dark, and it isn't mine to tell.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.done.2: I've told you everything I saw. If you find out more, come tell me. I'd like to hear one new thing.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.done.3: That's the whole of it. Keep a light on where you sleep. It doesn't do anything, but I'd feel better.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.story.generic.1: So you just woke up in the wrong century. Well. There's worse luck, and I've met most of it. Thank you for telling me. Ask me what you want.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.story.generic.2: Huh. That's more than I expected, and less than I hoped. A real person, from a real before. Ask your questions, I owe you answers.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.story.generic.3: That helps, knowing it. I used to think there was a before. Hearing you say it, I believe it again. Ask me anything.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.story.start.timel: You fell out of your own time too? Then you're not the first one the city swallowed, but you're the first one I've met. You must be scared stiff. Ask me what you need.
Out of your own time and into this one. I'm sorry. Truly. Whatever you left, it's still there, a long way back. Ask me what you need to know.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.story.start.skyfa: Fell from the sky? Then the sky still works for somebody. That's more than I've heard in a year. Ask me anything.
Dropped out of the sky into this mess. I've had worse landings. Ask me whatever you like.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.story.start.villa: A village. With a bell, and people who knew your name? I'd forgotten those were a thing. Ask me anything you want.
Small village, real neighbors. You have no idea what that sounds like to me. Ask, go on.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.story.start.burne: Your home burned. I'm sorry. Mine just went dark, which is quieter and somehow worse. Ask me what you want.
Fire took your place. Mine went the slow way, one light at a time. Ask me what you want.
You grew up out in the wild. Then you know about dark and quiet. Out here, that's most of what's left to know. Ask me anything.
The wild raised you, huh. Then none of this will surprise you as much as it did me. Ask me anything.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.story.start.shipw: Shipwrecked. And now you've washed up here, of all the shores. That takes some doing. Ask me anything.
Wrecked on the water and wrecked on the time. Somebody's keeping a record of you, I hope. Ask me what you need.
You came up out of a cave. Honestly, that's the safest place I can think of. Ask me whatever you like.
Down in a cave all that time. You picked the right hole. Ask me what you want to know.
A city. A real one, with streetlights that stayed on? Say that again slowly. Ask me anything you like.
A busy city, people on every corner. I'd give a lot to see that once more. Ask me anything.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.story.start.snowe: Snowed in on a pass. You know what waiting for something to end feels like, then. Ask me what you want.
Cold and quiet and nobody coming. We have more in common than you'd think. Ask me what you want.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.story.heritage.em: Warm as a stove, aren't you. Better than anyone else I've met out here. Ask me what you need.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.story.heritage.fr: You carry the cold with you. Out here, that keeps the dead from noticing you, I'd guess. Ask me what you need.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.story.heritage.st: Stone in the bones. The old walls here could have used somebody like you. Ask me what you need.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.story.heritage.ti: Water people. We lost the harbor first, if that means anything. Ask me what you need.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.story.heritage.sy: Forest folk. There aren't any trees left here worth the name. I'm sorry. Ask me what you need.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.story.heritage.ni: Born to the night. You picked a good place for it, it's always night here. Ask me what you need.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.story.heritage.ea: A plain Earthling, like me. I mean that as the best thing I can say. Ask me what you need.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.piece.0.1: Los Perrito went dark district by district. The harbor first, then the old market, then Main Street. By the time anyone thought to count, there was nobody left in the control room to count with.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.piece.0.2: It was a good city. Bright, loud, buses until three in the morning. Then the lights started going out one block at a time, and the buses stopped coming.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.piece.1.1: The tin ones were ours, remember that. They swept the streets, ran the crossings, carried the groceries. One morning they stopped answering and started marching. They kept their formation the whole time, I'll give them that.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.piece.1.2: Nobody saw it turn. The androids were just there, then they were all looking the same direction. Same step. Same hour. Nobody has found out why.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.piece.2.1: And then the dead got up. Not all at once, just a few more every night at the edges. We kept thinking the next wall would hold.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.piece.2.2: The dead walk after dark, and out here it's always after dark. They don't hurry. They don't need to.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.piece.3.1: They gave us the Omens because there was nothing else left to give. A machine you wear like a coat, with a hatch and a seat. I trained three weeks. The instructor trained one.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.piece.3.2: The Omens are the red and the blue ones. Same frame, different paint. They were meant to be a parade. Nobody ever had the parade.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.piece.4.1: We held the bridge as long as there were buses to hold it for. The last one got out, I think. Nobody came back to tell me.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.piece.4.2: The last stand was the east bridge. Six Omens at the start. I'm not going to say how many at the end.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.piece.5.1: The little drones are Worky. They map the streets, find a way through if there is one, and tell you when there isn't. Be nice to them. They're the only ones left who still ask if you're okay.
talk.jaymospowers.omen.piece.5.2: Worky doesn't sleep and doesn't leave. It'll hover over your shoulder and show you the clear way. Most days it's the best company I've got.
